statement: Euronext '2026 Holiday Calendar for Euronext's Cash and Derivatives markets', column Paris: 'The Euronext Cash Markets and the Euronext Derivatives Markets will be open Monday to Friday throughout 2026 except on the following days'. Closed: 1 January, 3 April (Good Friday), 6 April (Easter Monday), 1 May, 25 December. Half Trading Day: 24 December and 31 December. Only 2026 is published, so the horizon ends on 2026-12-31.

sources.covers: Euronext notice IF251107CADE (file dated 2025-11-07; its header reads '07 November 2026', copyright 2025): same table
'Appendix of Trading Manual 4-01', effective 19 October 2026, 'Trading hours in CET': continuous equities groups on Paris: opening uncross 09:00, continuous trading 09:00-17:30, closing uncross 17:35

early_closes: Half Trading Day; Euronext: 'End of year trading hours, including half day trading, will be announced in an end of year appendix to the Euronext Instructions 4-01 4-03 Trading Manuals.' Close time not yet published (only the 2025 appendix was linked on 2026-10-22).

Half Trading Day; Euronext: 'End of year trading hours, including half day trading, will be announced in an end of year appendix to the Euronext Instructions 4-01 4-03 Trading Manuals.' Close time not yet published (only the 2025 appendix was linked on 2026-10-22).
notes: regular_session is the continuous-trading phase of continuous ('C') equity groups; double-fixing ('DU') groups trade only in auctions at 11:30 and 16:30 and are not represented.
Half Trading Days are recorded as early closes with an unknown close time; session() raises SessionTimeUnknown for them until the 2026 end-of-year appendix is retrieved.
Settlement is counted on T2S-EUR, not on this file.
